answer_text: Intermittent drops at a Chicago site can be related to PoP handoffs. The CMA supports automatic PoP selection; set the site to Automatic (or City-based) so it connects to the best PoP. If a drop occurs and the SLA thresholds are at risk, you can use Reconnect to Preferred PoP to move the site to a different PoP. Use Site Experience Monitoring to view site metrics during the incident and investigate latency, jitter, or packet loss; the monitoring drill-down page provides the details you need. If you’d like, I can guide you through adjusting these settings in CMA.
